dataMigrationCreateBody: Bundle selected workspaces, conversation history, attachments, designs, Work state, and portable settings.
dataMigrationImportBody: Inspect and safely restore a Kun package, including one created on Windows, macOS, or Linux.
dataMigrationNeverTransferredBody: API keys, account tokens, OS keychain entries, machine identities, runtime caches, logs, temporary files, and previously granted trust or approvals are never included.
dataMigrationCreateRunBody: Kun writes to a temporary file, validates it, then atomically publishes the final package.
dataMigrationImportRunBody: Kun stages and validates the package before applying an all-or-nothing transaction.
dataMigrationReportBody: This report records what changed and anything that still needs review.
dataMigrationCancellation_stop: Cancellation stops before any destination changes.
dataMigrationCancellation_rollback: Cancellation rolls back changes already applied.
dataMigrationConfirmReplace: Replace existing data after creating migration backups? Independently modified paths will be preserved during rollback.
dataMigrationConfirmCancel_stop: Cancel this migration before it changes any destination data?
dataMigrationConfirmCancel_cleanup: Cancel this migration and remove its staged temporary data?
dataMigrationConfirmCancel_rollback: Cancel after the current atomic action and roll back changes already applied? Keep Kun open until rollback finishes.
labComposerPersonaEnabledDesc: When enabled, the chat composer shows the persona picker and sends the selected persona with new messages. Disabling it hides the picker and stops attaching personas.
labPlanWorktreeDescription: Direct plans run in an Agent-managed Git worktree by default.
labPlanWorktreeEnabled: Use Agent-managed worktrees for Direct plans by default
labPlanWorktreeEnabledDesc: You can temporarily build an individual Direct plan in the current workspace. Graph builds are unchanged.
fastContextDescription: Fast Context is enabled by default. The main agent can use its bounded, read-only repository retrieval to gather evidence with grep, glob, and read; it never edits files. Disabling it removes the tool from the agent's tool list.
fastContextEnabledDesc: Fast Context is enabled by default and is preferred for repository investigation.
fastContextModelModeDesc: Follow the main session model by default, or pin a fixed provider/model for Fast Context runs.
fastContextModelDesc: Provider and model used for Fast Context child runs. Overrides are still capped by the parent turn's authorized model set.
fastContextReasoningDesc: Reasoning depth for Fast Context child requests. Follow main inherits the session's effort.
fastContextFastDesc: Sends service_tier=priority for Fast Context requests. Only effective for Codex models that support priority.
fastContextFastUnsupportedHint: Fast mode is only available for Codex models that advertise priority support. The selected model cannot use it.
labPptDescription: First-class native PPTX tool (ppt_agent): the main agent only routes the exact active request and attachments to an isolated PPT child. The child follows Kun's governed design policy and category guides, supports visual review, and produces an editable PPTD project plus a validated .pptx. Disabling it removes the tool from every main agent's tool list.
labPptEnabledDesc: When enabled, ppt_agent appears in the main agent tool list and is preferred for native or format-unspecified presentation tasks.
labPptModelModeDesc: Follows the main session model by default; you can pin a provider/model for ppt_agent.
labPptModelDesc: Provider and model used by the ppt_agent child; overrides are still bounded by the parent turn's authorized models.
labPptReasoningDesc: Reasoning effort for ppt_agent child requests; inherits the session effort when following the main model.
labPptFastDesc: Sends service_tier=priority for ppt_agent requests. Only effective for Codex models that advertise priority support.
labPptFastUnsupportedHint: Fast mode is only available for Codex models that advertise priority support. The selected model cannot use it.
labPptImageFirstDesc: Generate a complete 16:9 slide preview set for whiteboard review before building the editable deck.
labPptImageFirstReadyHint: Image generation is available. PPT tasks will start with a reviewable visual slide set.
labPptImageFirstReferenceEditHint: The current protocol supports precise reference-image revisions.
labPptImageFirstRegenerateOnlyHint: The current protocol cannot edit references precisely; reviewed pages will be regenerated as complete slides.
labPptImageFirstUnavailableHint: Image generation is not available, so PPT tasks will use the direct editable-deck workflow. Configure an image model to enable visual-first review.
graphSettingsDescription: The Lead agent builds a durable task graph, delegates bounded nodes to workers, supervises progress, reviews results, and returns one synthesis.
graphSettingsSafety: Graph state is event-sourced and project-scoped. Workers cannot delegate, govern agents, or exceed the parent turn's tool, file, network, approval, or sandbox authority.
graphSettingsEnableDesc: Adds Direct / Graph selection to the main Code composer and enables durable Graph runs.
graphSettingsDefaultStrategyDesc: Direct preserves existing behavior. Graph uses orchestration for each new Code turn unless changed in the composer.
graphSettingsWorkerModelModeDesc: Workers follow the current Lead model by default. A fixed selection applies only to implicit Graph workers and stays inside the run's authorized model set.
graphSettingsWorkerModelDesc: Select the provider and model used for implicit worker assignments. Explicit authorized node profiles still take priority.
graphSettingsWorkerReasoningDesc: Choose the reasoning effort for implicit Graph workers using the fixed model. Follow Lead inherits the source turn's effort.
graphSettingsGlobalConcurrencyDesc: Maximum worker nodes scheduled across all active Graph runs.
graphSettingsConcurrencyDesc: Maximum worker nodes that one Graph run may execute at once.
graphSettingsMaxNodesDesc: Validation rejects generated or revised plans above this hard limit.
graphSettingsAttemptsDesc: Hard retry cap including repairs and restart recovery.
graphSettingsLoopsDesc: Global hard cap for validated loop gates; zero prohibits cycles.
graphSettingsRunHoursDesc: Maximum wall-clock lifetime of one Graph run, including pauses and recovery.
graphSettingsWriteIsolationDesc: Serialize overlapping writes, lease path scopes, or isolate workers in Git worktrees.
graphSettingsSupervisionDesc: Coalesce runtime signals into serialized Lead supervision turns.
graphSettingsFinalReviewDesc: Do not synthesize completion until the configured independent review gates pass.
graphSettingsCriticalHumanDesc: Critical-risk nodes stop for an explicit user decision.
graphSettingsLearningDesc: Asynchronously identify repeated verified patterns; learned capabilities never silently expand authority.
graphSettingsLearningSessionsDesc: Minimum separate conversations that must show the same verified pattern.
graphSettingsVerifiedEpisodesDesc: Minimum successful sanitized run episodes before creating a candidate.
graphSettingsProbationRunsDesc: Minimum measured low-risk runs before a candidate can become trusted.
graphSettingsReadOnlyExploreDesc: Allow bounded exploration for missing reusable capabilities without write authority.
graphSettingsDormancyDesc: Relevant, eligible routing opportunities missed before a trusted agent is demoted to dormant.
graphSettingsGraphRetentionDesc: How long terminal run journals and snapshots remain available.
graphSettingsEpisodeRetentionDesc: How long sanitized Episodes remain available for consolidation.
storageRelocationSubtitle: Move large Kun data to another local drive without breaking existing paths.
storageRelocationCurrentBody: The C-drive paths stay compatible while the physical data can live on another fixed NTFS drive.
storageRelocationDisabled: Storage relocation is not enabled in this build.
storageRelocationRestoreConfirm: Restore Kun data to the default C-drive location? Kun will restart and verify the restored data before deleting the old copy.
storageRelocationScopeBody: .kun and real content in .deepseekgui move. The Kun installation, %APPDATA%\Kun, and .devin stay on C. Explorer may show the target size when measuring a junction.
storageRelocationActiveWorkTitle: Kun must interrupt these active items
storageRelocationInterruptConfirm: I understand these items will be interrupted before Kun restarts.
storageRelocationOutcome_cleanup-pending: New location is active; old data cleanup is pending
storageRelocationPhase_cleanup-pending: Waiting to clean the old data
uninstallSubtitle: Remove Kun from this device. Optionally delete every local file, including settings, conversations, logs, and caches.
uninstallDataTitle: Local data that will be deleted
uninstallDataBody: Tick the option below to permanently delete these paths. This cannot be undone.
uninstallDeleteData: Delete all local data (settings, conversations, logs, caches, and the Kun data directory)
uninstallNoDataFound: No local data found to delete.
uninstallWarningBody: The selected data is removed immediately and cannot be recovered. Kun will close when the uninstall starts.
uninstallConfirmBody: This removes everything you selected and closes Kun. It cannot be undone.
uninstallConfirmAcknowledge: I understand that this cannot be undone
uninstallRunning: Uninstalling… Kun will close in a moment.
labConversationVisualizationDescription: Experimental structured visuals for flows, grouped explanations, and important constraints. The agent uses them only when spatial structure is clearer than prose.
labConversationVisualizationEnabledDesc: Adds show_visualization to future desktop agent requests. Turning it off removes the tool while preserving visualizations already stored in conversation history.
